lockFileMaintenance.description: Renovate's vulnerability-alert PRs (native GitHub alerts + osvVulnerabilityAlerts above) only target direct dependencies it extracts from package.json - a vulnerable transitive dependency (e.g. js-yaml/@humanfs/node pulled in by eslint) doesn't get its own remediation PR even when the parent's already-declared semver range permits the patched version. This does a periodic full lockfile refresh instead, which picks those up automatically since npm just re-resolves within existing ranges.

packageRules.description: Automerge minor/patch/pin/digest updates via PR once CI passes. main now requires a PR + passing status checks (branch protection), so a direct branch push (the previous automergeType) would just be rejected - this still ends up hands-off, but with an actual CI gate and a paper trail instead of a silent direct push.
eslint-config-next's plugins (eslint-plugin-react, typescript-eslint) do not support ESLint 10 yet - it crashes on any lint run. Unpin once they do.

typescript-eslint (even latest) only supports typescript <6.1.0. TS7 doesn't just warn on the peer mismatch, it crashes `npm run lint` outright (TypeError reading 'Cjs' in typescript-estree's create-program). tsc itself is fine on 7 - this is purely about the lint toolchain. Unpin once typescript-eslint supports it.
